<p>This is a course on the fundamentals of (structured) programming. We will start out simple, with a "HelloWorld" program, advance to programs reading several values, performing simple calculations or implement simple logic. In the course of the semester complexity will grow and eventually you will be able to implement a text menu based application with some rather complex algorithms and code under the hood.</p>

<p>The acquired skills and knowledge are fundamental for several software engineering related courses of the following semesters, such as Object Oriented Programming Lab, Software Architectures, Web Technologies, Web Development or Distributed Systems.</p>

<p>You will also be introduced to problem solving strategies like divide-and-conquer or reduce-and-conquer, thereby training your analytic and problem solving skills. You will study some fundamental computer science/IT concepts like flow and flow control, iteration, selection or interfacing, which are amongst the basic building blocks of most IT/business informatics activities and tasks.</p>
